description: Mastercam linkage plate (3222 tris) — 1.3.0 ground truth measured on the mesh (130-arcs): 17 cylindrical walls on 9 distinct axis/radius pairs and 2 conical chamfer frustums; no counterbore (the coaxial larger cylinders are the outer profile arcs R30/R17). Every radius below is the least-squares fit to the mesh, max vertex residual <= 7.5e-6 mm.

provenance.statement: Mastercam STLB export copied verbatim from ~/Desktop/test.stl to tests/corpus/; not generator output and not rewritten.

recoverable.note: hole A through-hole wall, one per plate; 112 tris each, maxVertexDev 1.70e-6

hole B through-hole wall, one per plate; 139 tris each, maxVertexDev 6.77e-6; staggered strip, 47 of 139 interior edges parallel to the axis. nSides is stl2step_corpus_check's D2 measurement (facet-normal bands extrapolated to a full turn, D-130-18(1)); the facet-normal band count itself is 137

outer profile arc, one per plate; maxVertexDev 3.94e-6. nSides is stl2step_corpus_check's D2 measurement (63 facet-normal bands over the 186.1 deg span, extrapolated to a full turn, D-130-18(1)); carried on this entry because the checker pairs each cylinder with the next nSides token, so without it the R17 value below was being compared against this arc

outer profile arc, span 180.00 deg, one per plate; 66 tris each, maxVertexDev 7.44e-6. nSides is stl2step_corpus_check's D2 measurement (33 facet-normal bands over 180 deg, extrapolated to a full turn, D-130-18(1)); the facet-normal band count itself is 33
cross bore through the block end, axis +X, 279 tris over 356.4 deg; maxVertexDev 2.02e-6
slot end, one per plate; maxVertexDev 9.49e-7
slot end, one per plate; maxVertexDev 1.01e-6
waist profile arc, span 57.65 deg, one per plate; 12 tris each, maxVertexDev 1.24e-6
waist profile arc, span 27.23 deg, one per plate; 6 tris each, maxVertexDev 4.41e-8

hole B mouth chamfer frustum, one per plate; 184 tris each, z=[-45,-44] and z=[-6,-5]. Semi-angle is the vertex fit: rims 8.499999994 and 9.500000125 exactly 1.0 mm apart in z, maxVertexDev 6.78e-6. The 45.017 deg in 130-arcs is the FACET-NORMAL angle of the 92-sided inscribed tessellation, atan(1/cos(pi/92)) = 45.0167059 deg, not the surface semi-angle.

live.partialReason: 1.3.0 floors from the mesh ground truth (130-arcs): 17 cylindrical walls (2x R12.625 closed360, 2x R8.5 closed360, 2x R30, 2x R17, 1x R10 axis +X, 2+2x R3 slot ends, 2+2x R5 waist arcs) and 2 ChamferCone frustums, watertight, smoothRevertedComponents=0. smoothExpectedExit=-1 is the sidecar skip-sentinel so corpus_engine_convert does not expected-red the glob; gate_130 owns the contract.
